7.4.2.5.6 Subfunction 0x03
UDS Service 0x19 with subfunction 0x03 allows an external tester to request all stored snapshot records for all DTCs in an ECU. Manager
[SWS_Dcm_01640] Support of UDS Service 0x19 with subfunction 0x03 Upstream requirements: RS_Diag_04250
⌈The Dcm shall support UDS Service 0x19 with subfunction 0x03 according to ISO 14229-1:2020 [9].⌋ When using paged buffer mechanism, in some case, it’s possible that the number of DTC matching the filter change between the calculation of the total size, needed for the first page transmission, and the sending of the further pages. For this reason, the requirement [SWS_Dcm_00587] and [SWS_Dcm_00588] define the behavior in these situations.
